title: Self-healing quercetin loaded hyaluronic dialdehyde conjugated aminoethyl-β-cyclodextrin and chitosan hydrogel via Schiff base reaction for enhanced anti-inflammatory activity
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,29254-29266
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA03329B, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Parichat Sutthisawatkul, Kanyalux Stapornpiriyadaj, Onuma Mongkhon, Weerasak Taengphan, Theerachart Leepasert, Thitinun Karpkird
HAD-ACD-HACC hydrogels, with their biocompatibility and pH-responsive properties, possess self-healing abilities. They serve as a biomaterial for controlled quercetin release, which enhances anti-inflammatory and wound healing activities.
